description:
9th Way Insignia is a service-disabled, veteran-owned small business bringing transformative technology to our government customers so they can achieve their missions.  Our specialties include cybersecurity, cloud modernization, software development, data analytics, enterprise architecture, enterprise IT, analytics, process automation, and artificial intelligence.  Learn more about 9th Way Insignia at https://9thwayinsignia.com/. 

 Application password: Niner

 Team (Project) Introduction 

 9th Way Insignia is seeking an Expert Power BI Developer   to support a government customer in Washington, DC.  The Expert Power BI Developer will support enterprise data modernization, reporting automation, dashboard development, and analytics initiatives across multiple business lines. This position aligns to the   Engineer 3   professional level within 9th Way Insignia’s career families and is expected to operate as a senior, technically strong resource who can support production delivery with minimal ramp-up time. 

 Professional Level Information 

 An Engineer, 3 typically plans and directs research or development work on complex projects, along with engaging various parties in design and development. Costs and recommendations of new components may also involve part of the job scope. Performs multiple engineering-related tasks in various assignments within the project and firm. An Engineer, 3 oversees the design, development, implementation, and analysis of technical products and systems. An Engineer, 3 has broad knowledge of engineering procedures and assists in the resolution of complex problems. An Engineer, 3 has strong technical skills and background, a knack for learning new technologies, and a blend of good problem-solving and innovation needed to resolve a wide variety of technical production challenges. 

 Functional Job (LCAT) Information 

 The Expert Power BI Developer serves as a senior technical contributor responsible for designing, developing, implementing, refining, and supporting complex Power BI dashboards, reports, semantic models, and data visualization solutions in support of enterprise reporting, analytics, and operational decision-making. This role is expected to go beyond visualization and be capable of supporting full-stack reporting solutions, including integration with source data, data transformation considerations, semantic model design, DAX development, performance tuning, and secure data presentation. 

 The Expert Power BI Developer must understand how data is structured, modeled, governed, and consumed across the enterprise   in order to   design scalable, reusable, and maintainable reporting solutions. This position works closely with ETL Developers, Data Analysts, Power Apps Developers, Technical Project Managers, Scrum Masters, testers, technical writers, and Government stakeholders to translate business needs into effective reporting and dashboard capabilities. The role also contributes to technical planning, ROM development, task   breakdowns, documentation, and identification of risks, dependencies, and efficiencies to support disciplined and predictable delivery. 

 Responsibilities 

 •    Be   available on Government site in Washington, DC during normal hours of operation.   

 •    Design , develop, enhance, and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, visualizations, semantic models, and related reporting solutions supporting enterprise operations and decision-making.   

 •    Analyze   data and business requirements to develop scalable, reusable, and user-friendly reporting products aligned to customer objectives.   

 •    Interpret   and implement business logic, calculations, rules, and reporting requirements within dashboards, reports, and workflow solutions.   

 •    Develop   and optimize data models, DAX measures, calculations, filters, drill paths, and   reporting   logic to support accurate and meaningful analysis.   

 •    Work   with materialized views and other prepared data structures to support efficient reporting and analytics solutions.   

 •    Convert   legacy OBIEE reports into Power BI reports and dashboards while preserving intended business logic and improving usability, maintainability, and performance.   

 •    Design , develop, and support automated workflows using Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Automate, to streamline reporting, approvals, notifications, and related business processes.   

 •    Work   closely with ETL developers, analysts, and stakeholders to ensure source data, business rules, and reporting logic are aligned and properly implemented.   

 •    Support   end-to-end reporting solution development, including data acquisition considerations, model design, visualization design, security, refresh strategies, workflow automation, and performance tuning.   

 •    Troubleshoot   and resolve complex dashboard, modeling, calculation, workflow, and performance issues in production and pre-production environments.   

 •    Support   agile delivery through participation in requirements analysis, backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint demonstrations, and incremental delivery of reporting and workflow capabilities.   

 •    Contribute   to minimum viable product development within defined timelines and incrementally mature functionality over multiple sprint cycles.   

 •    Develop   and maintain documentation as part of normal delivery activities, including report specifications, data definitions, dashboard logic documentation, workflow documentation, runbooks, and operational procedures.   

 •    Provide   technical recommendations regarding solution design, report structure, workflow approaches, modeling methods, task sequencing, ROM estimates, and opportunities for efficiency or reuse.   

 •    Support   role-based access design and secure presentation of data in accordance with Government and enterprise requirements.   

 •    Promote   standard delivery approaches, consistent reporting and workflow design practices, and maintainable development standards.   

 •    Work   across multiple business lines and enterprise priorities as needed to support customer mission requirements.   

 •    Mentor   less   senior developers and support the overall quality, usability, and maintainability of reporting deliverables.   

 •    Other   responsibilities as assigned. 
 

 Requirements 

 •     Masters ’s   degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Data Analytics, Mathematics, or other technical discipline. Additional relevant experience may be substituted for a degree consistent with contract requirements.   

 •    Minimum   15   years   of relevant experience in business intelligence, dashboard development, reporting, data visualization, data analytics, or related technical delivery roles.   10 additional years of experience in lieu of degree.   

 •    Demonstrated   experience designing and implementing complex Power BI dashboards, reports, and semantic models in production environments.   

 •    Strong   data analytics experience and ability to analyze datasets, interpret trends, and translate business needs into effective reporting and workflow solutions.   

 •    Strong   experience with DAX, data modeling, visualization design, and development of scalable reporting solutions.   

 •    Experience   interpreting and implementing business logic, reporting rules, and functional requirements in technical solutions.   

 •    Experience   working with materialized views, prepared data structures, and integrated data sources to support reporting and analytics needs.   

 •    Experience   converting OBIEE reports into Power BI reports and dashboards.   

 •    Experience   developing automated workflows using Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Automate.   

 •    Experience   supporting report performance tuning, refresh strategies, workflow optimization, and reporting environment performance.   

 •    Experience   supporting agile or iterative technical delivery efforts with backlog-driven work, sprint-based execution, and incremental releases.   

 •    Experience   developing technical and user-facing documentation including report specifications, workflow documentation, runbooks, data definitions, and operational procedures.   

 •    Ability   to operate effectively in an enterprise production environment with minimal ramp-up time.   

 •    Must   be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S.   

 •    Must   be able to obtain and maintain the required security clearance. 

   

 Preferred/Desired 

 •    Experience   supporting federal government customers in enterprise data warehouse, reporting, or analytics environments.   

 •    Experience   with ETL processes, data integration concepts, and upstream data dependencies that support reporting solutions.   

 •    Experience   supporting full-stack reporting solutions, including data preparation, semantic model design, visualization delivery, and workflow automation.   

 •    Experience   with Microsoft Power Platform tools in governed enterprise environments, including Power Apps and Power Automate.   

 •    Experience   contributing to ROM development, effort estimation, and technical planning inputs for governance or change control discussions.   

 •    Experience   working in environments emphasizing process maturity, repeatability, documentation, and disciplined delivery practices.   

 •    Current   Public Trust or ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance quickly. 
 Salary Range
 $120,518 — $150,000 USD 


 9th Way Insignia’s range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law. 

 Clearance/Background Investigation 
Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

 Benefits 
Eligible employees will have access to our comprehensive benefits package which includes Medical, Dental, Vision, Voluntary Life Insurance, 401(k), Basic Life A&D, STD, LTD, PTO, Telehealth, paid holidays, FSA, HSA. Additional resources include our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and Traveling Assistance.

 Legal 
We’re an equal employment opportunity employer that empowers our people to fearlessly drive change – no matter their race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, lactation, or related medical conditions), national origin, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, military or uniformed service member status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

 Equal Employment Opportunity Notice 
Applicants have the right to be free from unlawful workplace discrimination. Please review the EEOC’s Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal notice. Accessible formats and translations are also available from the EEOC.

 Application Accommodations 
If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete this application or participate in the hiring process, please contact hr@insigniatechnology.com. Requests will be considered individually.
